paper.title: EgoDex: Learning Dexterous Manipulation from Large-Scale Egocentric Video

claim: 即使是 Apple Vision Pro/ARKit 生产级采集时追踪，其灵巧手部标注在重度遮挡（如叠毛巾）或非常高速的运动下也会不完美，因为标注本身是模型预测。

evidence.summary: 作者在结论局限段明确承认标注在重度遮挡与高速运动下 imperfect，并指出标注是模型预测。
evidence.short_quote: The dexterous annotations can also be imperfect, especially during heavy occlusion (e.g., towel folding) or very high speed motions, as they are themselves model predictions.

core_citations.reason: 事后手部重建方法的对照，支撑 C02 的管线论证

paper_reading.relation: 误差来源：遮挡与高速运动是 ego 手部追踪标注精度的两个具体失效条件；'采集时追踪'并非金标准，标注噪声在最高质量管线中依然存在。
paper_reading.verification_rationale: 第 7 节原文逐字匹配；claim 仅为作者自述局限，未外推失效的频率或误差量。

paper.title: EgoDex: Learning Dexterous Manipulation from Large-Scale Egocentric Video

claim: EgoDex 的手部标注在采集时由 Vision Pro 的多相机、已知内外参与生产级手部预测网络共同产生；作者论证事后手部预测网络（如 HaMeR 用于网络视频）在缺少多视角与时刻相机外参时预测质量会受损。

evidence.summary: 2.3 节对比两种标注路径并给出设计理由；abstract 与 3.1 节确认 ARKit/on-device SLAM 来源。
evidence.locator: Section 2.3 Learning from Human Video (extraction block: background)
evidence.short_quote: quality of these networks can suffer without multiple viewpoints and detailed knowledge of the camera extrinsics at all times, usually unavailable with raw Internet video. In contrast, the EgoDex dataset includes 3D head and hand tracking at the time of collection, where multiple cameras on the Vision Pro, known intrinsics and extrinsics, and a production-grade hand prediction network all contribute to precise annotation.

paper.title: EgoDex: Learning Dexterous Manipulation from Large-Scale Egocentric Video

claim: 以 ARKit 采集时追踪为真值的 EgoDex 基准上，SOTA 模仿策略预测双手 48 维腕部+指尖轨迹的平均 3D 关键点误差约 4.4-4.5 cm（2 秒 horizon，K=1）；预测 horizon 加长误差增大（H=1s/2s/3s 时 Dec+BC 平均距离分别为 0.031/0.045/0.053 m）。

evidence.summary: 表 2 给出各模型 2s horizon 的 Avg/Final Distance，表 3 给出 horizon 消融数值；指标定义为 12 个 3D 关键点（双腕+双手指尖）的欧氏距离。
evidence.short_quote: Results for models trained and evaluated with different prediction horizons. As expected, accuracy falls as the prediction horizon increases.

paper_reading.relation: 可接受阈值：即使手部标注质量很高，策略层面的腕部/指尖轨迹预测仍有厘米级误差且随时域增长；为重定向后末端轨迹的可达精度提供量级基线。
paper_reading.verification_rationale: 表 2/表 3 数值逐行核对（Dec+BC 行 0.031/0.045/0.053；表 2 最佳 K=1 为 0.044）；claim 限定于该基准与模型集合，未断言机器人执行精度。

quantitative.metric: Avg Distance (m) of 3D keypoints (wrists + fingertips), best-of-K
quantitative.comparator: best K=1 models at 2s horizon: 0.044-0.045 m (EncDec+BC / Dec+BC)
